rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope and finding (F1); i8949 p. 8, code B: "You received a Form 1099-B or Form 1099-DA (or substitute statement) and the basis shown in box 1e on Form 1099-B or box 1g on Form 1099-DA is incorrect"; f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i1040sd p. 11, line 18: "Collectibles include works of art, rugs, antiques, metals (such as gold, silver, and platinum bullion), gems, stamps, coins, alcoholic beverages, and certain other tangible property. Include on the worksheet any gain (but not loss) from the sale or exchange of an interest in a partnership, S corporation, or trust held for more than 1 year and attributable to unrealized appreciation of collectibles.". executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.deepseek.json`; 1,382 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 630 partial records from 40 bases; 2,245 comparisons; every witness re-read from an uncapped scratch re-run of triage.mjs, same counts): 2,166 of 2,245 agree; 70 candidate-unknown (28 completed), 7 value (none completed), 2 candidate-refuses (none completed). (1) The reply adds boxes G and J to the reported-basis boxes; the 7 values are all box G or J entries (generated 8, 21, 92, 160, 256, 357, 470), every one refused; Boxes G and J (and H, I, K, L) are refused for the return by sales.digital at sales.one (checked: sales.refuse.digital.G and generated 8, 21, 92, 160, 256, 357, 470 refuse Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 on sales.digital). (2) The 28 completed candidate-unknown are partial records withholding sales.special, which the reply declares on the line: Finding F1 (SCREEN-UNANSWERED-PASSES, `sales.findings.md`): with sales.special or sales.aggregate_eligible unanswered, sales.one is unknown, but sd.screen (sd.count < 0) evaluates false through the engine's Count lower-bound shortcut, so the return completes as if the screen were answered no; the candidate correctly needs the answer. Witnesses: partial(classm.f8889.1.deepseek -special), project Form 1040 line 16 $18,089.13 computed, candidate unknown; with special true the return refuses. (3) The candidate-refuses on special are on refused returns (sales.refuse.special, generated 380): scope. BUG-0231 widened only the sales.special question (shares of an exchange-traded fund or trust holding gold, silver, platinum or other metals), which matches i1040sd p. 11 ("metals" and an interest in a "trust ... attributable to unrealized appreciation of collectibles"); a wider reading of it can only refuse. Project stands on this line.
